note: BH-9421 (lead BLOCK on #9469): minutes after a build job for the key finishes before the lever may release its still-claimed build_queue row. On the fly path fly-pool (every 10 min) closes the row only when it collects the result, so a finished build looks like an orphan until then. 20 = two fly-pool cycles. A build job opened at or after claimed_at always declines the release, whatever its status. Out of range is one warn line and the default.
